title: OpenAI and CodeAI plan free AI-literacy programs for students
friendlyTitle: Students will get more help learning how AI really works
summary: OpenAI and CodeAI announced a year of student and teacher programs spanning basic AI literacy, a high-school builders challenge, classroom resources, career sessions, and an advisory council focused on child development and learning. The partnership accompanies ChatGPT for Teens and CodeAI’s free AI Foundations course.
friendlySummary: OpenAI and CodeAI are creating free lessons, projects, and career programs to help students and teachers understand AI.
whyItMatters: For families and schools, the emphasis on questioning outputs and understanding limitations is more useful than simply expanding chatbot access; implementation quality and independent evaluation will determine the program’s value.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Young people need to check AI answers and know its limits, not only learn how to use a chatbot.
